test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 47 masons can dig a 35 m long trench in one day. How many masons should be employed for digging a 105 m long trench of the same type in one day?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the time remains constant (1 day), the number of masons is directly proportional to the length of the trench.

Work ratio = 105 m ÷ 35 m = 3

Therefore, required masons = Initial masons × 3

Required masons = 47 × 3 = 141

**∴ The correct answer is 141 masons.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial masons (M₁) = 47

Initial trench length (W₁) = 35 m

Initial days (D₁) = 1 day

Final trench length (W₂) = 105 m

Final days (D₂) = 1 day

**Formula Used:**

MDH Rule: (M₁ × D₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂) ÷ W₂

 
 Work = 35 m
 
 
 47 Masons
 
 
 Work = 105 m
 
 
 141 Masons
 
 

 

 × 3
 
 

 

 × 3
 
 
• 
 
• 

**Calculation:**

⇒ (47 × 1) ÷ 35 = (M₂ × 1) ÷ 105

⇒ 47 ÷ 35 = M₂ ÷ 105

⇒ M₂ = (47 × 105) ÷ 35

⇒ M₂ = 47 × 3

⇒ M₂ = 141

**∴ The correct answer is 141 masons.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule (MDH Concept)

The relationship between Men (M), Days (D), Hours (H), and Work (W) is given by (M₁ × D₁ × H₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) ÷ W₂.

Direct Proportion

If two quantities are directly related (e.g., Work and Men), an increase in one results in a proportional increase in the other. In this case, M ∝ W.

Inverse Proportion

If two quantities are inversely related (e.g., Men and Days), an increase in one results in a proportional decrease in the other. In that case, M ∝ 1 ÷ D.
